status: Windows x64 update: two-step Cloudflare connection setup. Mac stays at 0.11.0, Android/Android TV at 0.11.1, Linux at 0.11.2.

checks.unitTests: 17 Windows baseline unit tests pass (connection, tunnel, planes, windows); production build and typecheck pass.
checks.liveTunnel: On a physical Windows 11 PC with a real Cloudflare tunnel: the pasted Windows command registered the bundled connector in about 1 s with the matching tunnel ID; the route Cloudflare pushed was detected and suggested; the public HTTPS address verified against the exact server instance; a wrong address was rejected.
checks.connectorDownload: With the bundled connector removed, the pinned cloudflared-windows-amd64.exe was downloaded from GitHub and accepted only after its size and SHA-256 matched.
checks.installedUpgrade: In-place silent NSIS upgrade from 0.11.0 on the same PC preserved the library, saved tunnel and public address; the upgraded server reported 0.11.3 locally and through its public HTTPS address.

limitations: Unsigned installer; SmartScreen may show an unknown publisher. Verify the SHA-256 before installing.
The full installed-application suite (windows-e2e) runs on disposable CI runners and was not rerun for this build.
The stop-old-cloudflared-service action (UAC prompt) was not exercised on a machine with such a service installed.

artifacts.role: Media server host: Lumio Stream server, Media Center and Administration
artifacts.intendedFor: Windows 10 and 11 x64, per-user install without elevation; upgrades 0.11.0 in place
